jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff — Internship / Visiting Researcher
jobs.note: Research category, listed as "Internship / Visiting Researcher", English. "We are occasionally hiring researchers who are passionate about novel approaches to develop the next generation of nature-inspired foundation AI models." No degree requirement stated. Apply by emailing careers@sakana.ai naming the role, then submit their Google Form with CV and cover letter in English.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (RSI Lab) — Internship / Visiting Researcher
jobs.note: Listed as "Full-time / Visiting Researcher / Internship". The Recursive Self-Improvement Lab works on redesigning the AI development process itself with AI. Apply by emailing careers@sakana.ai naming the role, then submit their Google Form.

jobs.title: Applied Research Engineer — Full-time / Contract / Intern
jobs.note: Product-side applied research (Sakana Chat, Marlin, Fugu), listed as "Full-time / Contract / Intern". Apply by emailing careers@sakana.ai naming the role, then submit their Google Form.

jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.note: Sea AI Lab is Sea Limited's research arm in Singapore (Fusionopolis), publishing at ICLR and ICML. Listed on their own careers page with no closing date.

jobs.title: Sea Industrial PhD Program (IPP)
jobs.note: Joint programme between SAIL and Singapore universities for graduate students doing AI research. Full tuition support plus a monthly salary. Not an internship but the closest thing on the board to a funded research position for a student.
